quality.statement: NO record is classified 'verified'. Figures were written from recalled published values and are 'unverified' with a subjective confidence tag. Derived values inherit unverified inputs. Optimization catalog values are estimated/fictional.

known_conflicts.note: Recorded GM (9.62e-5 km3/s2) and mass (1.4762e15 kg) disagree by ~2.4% via GM=G*M; both retained, GM preferred for orbital use; resolve against JPL SSD sat_phys_par.
For irregular bodies (Phobos, Deimos, Bennu, Enceladus) g=mu/R^2 is a spherical approximation; recorded g is a mean/typical value.

known_conflicts.preferred: 33.4 MN design value recorded; flight values vary by mission

known_conflicts.note: Recorded liftoff mass minus recorded stage masses leaves ~31 t, more than payload+fairing implies; at least one input (stage dry mass or liftoff mass) is likely off. See analysis/mass_analysis.json.

Recorded stage dry+propellant masses sum exactly to liftoff mass, leaving no room for payload/fairing; ideal dv in propulsion_analysis (~11.6-12 km/s) is therefore an overestimate and not a credible ascent number. Needs retrieval of the payload user's guide.
Core-stage-only accounting (boosters excluded); stack residual is dominated by booster/upper-stage mass, so the ideal-dv total is not a vehicle capability.
Several missions flew Atlas V 401/411/541 variants not in the launch dataset; launch_vehicle_id is null for them.
